title: From particle size to brain function: a zebrafish-based review of micro/nanoplastic-induced neurobehavioral toxicity and mechanistic pathways
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4197-4210
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00469A, Critical Review
Da Sun, Baihui Wu, Jinghui Yue, Guomeng Zeng, Rongbing Chen, Jia Chen
Micro- and nanoplastics (MPs/NPs) are emerging neurotoxicants in aquatic environments, with increasing evidence linking their presence to behavioral impairments and molecular disruption in fish.
